minutes.headline: Committee voted to hire Shawmut Design and Construction as construction manager at risk for the school project.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the selected construction manager's abbreviated presentation on team, schedule, site logistics and safety, then moved and seconded a motion to contract for preconstruction services. The architect gave a design update on the floor plan, a new soccer field, the cost estimate schedule and MSBA deadlines, and members asked about roof alternatives, future expansion and enrollment. The next meeting date and community outreach plans were also discussed.

votes.motion: Contract with Shawmut Design and Construction as construction manager at risk (preconstruction contract)

budget_items.what_was_said: Two invoices: one for regular services, and one for the feasibility study of the current building plus a geotechnical add-on.
The committee moved to contract with the selected firm for preconstruction services, with the contract to go to legal.
The cost estimate is due to the MSBA two weeks before its board meeting, with a September target date.

Community outreach working group to continue developing an FAQ, schedule of community meetings and handout; volunteers invited.

what_happened.line: The committee moved and seconded a motion to contract with Shawmut Design and Construction as construction manager at risk for preconstruction services; the vote was not audible.
The contract is to go to legal before it is finalized.
The architect gave a design update, and the cost estimate is due to the MSBA two weeks before its board meeting, with a September target.

why_it_matters: Choosing the construction manager sets who will price and build the school project, which feeds the cost estimate that residents will later be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
The MSBA estimate deadline and the outreach meetings are the points where the project's cost and timing become public before any vote.
